timeline.tweet: Hello Saturday 🔅 I am about to work out. I have been busy lately and I know it helps my anxiety so much. Let's go!!! 💪 What are you all doing today?
That is so good!!!!! I am going to workout at home as I have so much work to do. Never tried yoga yet, so far I have heard that it is awesome? Have a good day :) - L

My to do list for today: - exercise ✔️ - healthy food ✔️ - work 🔸I used to be so obsessed about everything that I had to do in a day and If I hadn't completed it, it would give me anxiety. Now I tell myself that it doesn't matter when and how. No reason to rush. #Selfcare

that's awfull. I did suffer that I used to get scared to go to bed because I knew it was going to be pointless. I started creating a night time routine with times, meditation, not social media,etc. Try and make one of your own. - Leti
One year ago I couldn't attend one of my exams. I stayed outside for 20 minutes but I couldn't do it, and it's fine. your body are mind are trying to tell you something. - L :)
It's hard. It takes time and effort. I ended up loving the fact that I want to be healthy so it is not about losing weight anymore. For me it's more about my health 💛 - leti
I don't know you but I am REALLY PROUD!!!!!!!! You have no idea how much I relate. I have been through the same situation. Uni literally ruined me, but I am almost done. 💛 - leti #MentalHealthMonth
It's finals in university. To students: keep the mind healthy to beat stress during this month. It's #MenntalHealthAwarenessMonth

I keep working on how to change the way my mind thinks. I need to understand that there is NOTHING wrong with doing nothing one day, or two, or a week. I am such a dinamic person. I always need to be doing something, which is not good. #mentalhealth

One year later I am a completely different person. I have changed a lot and my mental health is really good. However, there's always something to keep working on. Now I am telling myself: 'leti is good that you were in bed all day, its ok' 💛#mentalhealth

The only reason why I almost dropped university was my mental health. Uni ruined me in a way I could never explain. It's so much pressure and they don't even think about the people who go through it. They make it harder. No room for people who struggle. #MentalHealthAwareness

My graduation. Before this day, I had struggled for three months with depression, anxiety and agoraphobia. I worked so hard to make it to this day, go on stage and get my diploma. Proud :) 💛 #SmilingWithMentalIllness
The #RoyalWedding was magical. I had an amazing time watching it. It made my day.
Hiiiii! Sorry that I haven't been interacting lately. I am very busy with university.. How's everyone doing???? 💛 Hope you like our daily challenges :) Love, Leti The Smile Tribe Team

When was the last time you went away, where would you like to go next? Are you a beach bather or a city explorer? #smile #smiletribe #holiday #beach #vacation #sun #happy #fun #smilechallenge #wesmiletogether

Hi Zoe I dropped university due to my depression and anxiety too. It was really hard to go back and find the balance with mental health and my studies. I know how it feels. I am really prouf of you!!! WE ROCK💛 - Leti

Changes are challenging. They are scary and if it's scary it is because it's worth the risk. DO IT :) YOU CAN! I just moved to London on my own and a year ago I had severe depression and anxiety. Anything is possible. Sending strenght :) - Leti

It gives me anxiety too. The media in general. I stopped watching the news and my personal Facebook and Twitter. Everything was sad. I only use this account because I love what I do and I help people! Take a break from social media.. you will see the change. :) - Leti

Overcoming my depression and anxiety and moving to England on my own after several months of agoraphobia. I had always been really independent and I had the fear that I was not going to be able to travel and be the same person I was before. But i do 😊

A-Level #ExamResults You are more than your exams. Keep that in mind. Don't let it affect your mental health. You are valuable as a person and that is more important that any other thing. You rock!!!!
sameee! I am trying really hard to work on what I eat nowadays. I know that it impacts my mental health!

uesThat's so sad to read... I hope you have other people who suuport you in your life! I dropped university too when I suffered from mental health issues Remember that you are a priority. You made the good decision! - Leti
Overcoming my mental health issues and keep doing things that I love. Example ... moving to another country although i suffered from a very bad agoraphobia. That's my biggest achivement! 💛 - Leti
